title: syngramma fraxinea
intro: Syngramma fraxinea, commonly known as the Ruffled fern, is a type of tropical fern native to Southeast Asia. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may aid in reducing symptoms of various conditions such as arthritis and anxiety. The therapeutic actions of Syngramma fraxinea include its potential to exhibit antimicrobial and antiviral properties, making it a subject of interest in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of the plant are still being researched, but it is believed to contain flavonoids, saponins, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
